# TechTide SEO

> TechTide SEO is an SEO agency based in Ikeja, Lagos, Nigeria. It helps businesses in Nigeria and worldwide get found on Google through SEO audits, technical SEO, on-page SEO, local SEO, content and link building, with clear plans and monthly reporting on leads and calls. Plans start from $500 per month.

## Key pages
- [Services](https://techtideseo.com/services/): Overview of all SEO services
- [SEO services in Nigeria](https://techtideseo.com/seo-services/nigeria/): What we offer Nigerian businesses
- [How we work and plans](https://techtideseo.com/how-we-work/): Process and pricing from $500 per month
- [Free SEO audit tool](https://techtideseo.com/seo-audit-tool/): Instant check of a web page
- [Free SEO audit request](https://techtideseo.com/free-seo-audit/): Request a human review
- [Guides](https://techtideseo.com/guides/): In-depth SEO guides and checklists
- [Blog](https://techtideseo.com/blog/): Long-form SEO articles
- [About](https://techtideseo.com/about/): The company and its approach
